title: Blood Sugar Sex Magik 35th Anniversary: Listen on SiriusXM
summary: Hear Anthony Kiedis, Flea, and Chad Smith take fans track by track through the landmark album all weekend long.
body_markdown:
The[Red Hot Chili Peppers](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/red-hot-chili-peppers) are celebrating the 35th anniversary of their landmark album *Blood Sugar Sex Magik* with an exclusive weekend of music and commentary on[Whole Lotta Red Hot (Ch. 315)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/whole-lotta-red-hot) .


[35 Years of Blood Sugar Sex Magik Exclusive track-by-track special Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBloodSugarSexMagikWholeLottaRedHot)


The main event is a new 90-minute track-by-track special hosted by[Anthony Kiedis](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/Anthony-Kiedis) ,[Flea](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/flea) , and[Chad Smith](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/chad-smith) , who revisit *Blood Sugar Sex Magik* and share stories and commentary about the album’s songs.


Throughout the anniversary weekend, listeners will also hear additional new commentary from the band leading into songs from *Blood Sugar Sex Magik* on Whole Lotta Red Hot.


Released September 24, 1991, *Blood Sugar Sex Magik* includes some of the band’s most enduring songs, including “Give It Away,” “Under the Bridge,” “Suck My Kiss,” and “Breaking the Girl.”


### ***Blood Sugar Sex Magik* 35th Anniversary Track-by-Track Schedule**


Hear the 90-minute track-by-track special at the following times (all times ET):


- **Thursday, September 24:** 9am, 3pm, and 9pm
- **Friday, September 25:** 12pm
- **Saturday, September 26:** 5pm
- **Sunday, September 27:** 12am and 6pm


The special will also be available to listen to on demand on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBloodSugarSexMagikWholeLottaRedHot) .


### **Whole Lotta Red Hot Takes Over Lithium**


On Thursday, September 24 — the 35th anniversary of *Blood Sugar Sex Magik* — Whole Lotta Red Hot will also take over[Lithium (Ch. 34)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/lithium) for the day, giving listeners another way to celebrate the album and the Red Hot Chili Peppers.
